heroes.name: Aldric
heroes.title: Shieldwarden of Aurel
heroes.lore:
Aldric Vane was nineteen when the Sundering split the Old Crown, and he spent that night on the walls of the Bastion of Aurel holding a shield taller than he was. The wall stood. Half the men beside him did not. Since then he has carried that shield into every siege and never once struck first, because the Dawnguard teach that a banner is held by those who refuse to move.

Marshal Hallen trained him, and the night Hallen fell in the ash fields and rose again among the Hollow was the only time Aldric ever lowered his guard. His sister Seraphine patches him up after every battle. The barbarian chief Hrodgar left a notch in his shield at the gates of Aurel and has been asked about it every winter since. Aldric always answers the same way: he is keeping it as a reminder to hit back harder.
heroes.quote: A banner does not fall while someone is still standing in front of it.

passive.name: Oathbound
passive.description: Every ability Aldric casts wraps him in a small shield. When he drops below 30% health he steels himself, gaining a surge of armor and magic resistance (long cooldown).

abilities.name: Shield Rush
abilities.description: Charges forward and slams into the first enemy in the way, damaging and briefly stunning them.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.description: Raises a rallying aura. Nearby allies and Aldric gain a burst of armor and magic resistance, and Aldric gains a shield.

abilities.name: Provoke
abilities.description: Bellows a challenge. Nearby enemies take damage and are forced to attack Aldric for a moment while he hardens his guard.

abilities.name: Bastion Unbroken
abilities.description: Plants himself and becomes unstoppable behind a huge shield, projecting a sanctuary that hardens every ally standing near him.

heroes.name: Hrodgar
heroes.title: Ironhide of the Stonefang
heroes.lore:
Hrodgar is chief of the Stonefang clan, and he earned the name Ironhide by surviving three winters of the Ashen Wilds with a spear through his shoulder and no one willing to pull it out. He fights in a cracked bronze cap, with a round shield and an axe he calls Stubborn. He does not understand why anyone would dodge a blow when a body can simply be made wide enough to absorb it.

He came south for the Banner Wars because the Ley Banners are rewriting the weather over the Wilds, and the clan elders say the old magic must be taken before the Crown's heirs take it all. At the gates of Aurel he put a notch in Aldric Vane's shield and has respected the knight ever since; the two trade grudging nods across the battlefield. His younger sister Skarra left the clan to chase glory in the arenas of Mareth. Hrodgar pretends not to read her letters, and keeps every one.
heroes.quote: You want to get past me? Then we will both be here a long while.

passive.name: Third Blow
passive.description: Every third basic attack deals bonus damage equal to a slice of the target's maximum health and heals Hrodgar. Devastating against bosses, camps and bulky heroes.

abilities.name: Chain Hook
abilities.description: Hurls a barbed chain. The first enemy it strikes is damaged and yanked straight to Hrodgar.

abilities.name: Earthshaker
abilities.description: Stamps the ground, damaging nearby enemies and slowing them. Scales with his health, and cracks towers apart.

abilities.name: Iron Will
abilities.description: Roars and shrugs off all crowd control for a moment, gaining a shield and a burst of speed to close the gap.

abilities.name: Rockfall Leap
abilities.description: Leaps to a point and crashes down like a falling boulder, damaging and launching every enemy in the landing zone. Towers in the landing zone take heavy damage.

heroes.name: Hallen
heroes.title: Marshal of the Unburied
heroes.lore:
Marshal Hallen led the Dawnguard's third legion for thirty years and died in the ash fields on the first night of the Sundering with his shield still raised. He woke three days later among his own fallen soldiers, thinking, with the infinite calm of a man who has been ordering retreats for most of his life, that the line had held. It had not. But he had, and that was enough to make him rise.

Hallen no longer fights for Aurel, nor for the Pact. He fights for the idea that the dead deserve a commander too, and he leads the Unburied: soldiers who answer to his voice because they have nowhere else to go. His former pupil Aldric Vane still salutes him on the field, which Hallen finds unbearable and quietly treasures. His old chaplain Zhal follows him everywhere, as does the scout Ossian, who has not forgiven the thing that killed him and has a long list of names.
heroes.quote: I buried my men once. I will not do it twice.

passive.name: Deathless
passive.description: The first time Hallen falls below 25% health he cannot be harmed for a moment and recovers a chunk of health. Long cooldown.

abilities.name: Hollow Bash
abilities.description: Smashes his shield into everything in front of him, damaging and shoving enemies back.

abilities.name: Muster the Fallen
abilities.description: Calls two bone soldiers from the earth to fight beside him, and gains a shield.

abilities.name: Spectral Chains
abilities.description: Marks an area. After a heartbeat, ghostly chains burst out and pin every enemy there in place.

abilities.name: Dead March
abilities.description: Sounds the old marching drum. A bone brute rises to guard him, and every ally nearby gets faster, hits faster and hardens for eight seconds.

heroes.name: Valen
heroes.title: The Sunblade
heroes.lore:
Valen Ashcroft is the Dawnguard's executioner, a title he hates and has never refused. When the Order must end a traitor, a fallen paladin or a Hollow that has gone feral, it sends the Sunblade: a two-handed greatsword forged from the melted bells of Aurel's first chapel. Valen does not gloat and does not hurry. He waits until the enemy is bleeding, then finishes it in a single stroke.

His one failure still keeps him awake. Three winters ago the Thornwood thief Sable Thorne walked out of the Bastion with the Order's Sun-Seal ring on her finger, and Valen, who had been guarding it, has chased her across Vael ever since. He trains with the barbarian Skarra whenever the road allows, because she is the only person alive who laughs when he wins. He is not yet sure whether that is a flaw in her or in him.
heroes.quote: Mercy is for those who still have something left to lose.

passive.name: Sun's Judgment
passive.description: Every third basic attack burns with holy fire, dealing bonus magic damage that grows the more wounded the target is.

abilities.name: Rising Slash
abilities.description: A wide upward cut that damages enemies in front of him and throws them into the air.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.description: Leaps at an enemy and strikes them, then attacks much faster for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.description: Raises his guard, taking far less damage. His next attack within a few seconds reaches farther and strikes back hard, slowing the target.

abilities.name: Final Verdict
abilities.description: Drops on a chosen enemy from above, dealing massive damage that grows with how wounded they already are. Any enemy left below 15% health is executed with true damage. The shockwave hurts everyone nearby.

heroes.name: Skarra
heroes.title: The Rampant
heroes.lore:
Skarra left the Stonefang clan at sixteen with a two-handed axe, a borrowed horse and a promise that her name would be sung louder than her brother's. The horse died in Mareth. The name did not take long: three winters in the Free City's arenas made her the Rampant, a woman who fights better the more it hurts and who has never been seen leaving a pit without a smile.

Her brother Hrodgar still sends letters, and she still answers them, though never with the truth about how many scars she has now. She has a running feud with Kraghul, the cursed gladiator she has beaten three times in the Karth-Mor pits, and who rose again each time. She spars with Valen of the Dawnguard whenever their paths cross, mostly because he never learned to laugh and she considers that a personal challenge.
heroes.quote: If it did not hurt a little, it was not a fight.

passive.name: Bloodrage
passive.description: Kills heal Skarra and put a spring in her step. When she falls below 30% health she flies into a rage, attacking much faster and stealing life with every blow.

abilities.name: Rending Throw
abilities.description: Hurls an axe that homes in on an enemy, wounding them and leaving a bleeding gash.

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.description: Spins her axe in a whirling storm for over a second, shredding everything around her and picking up speed. Great against waves.

abilities.name: Savage Leap
abilities.description: Vaults to a point and lands with a crushing blow, then fights with frenzied speed for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Blood Whirlwind
abilities.description: Erupts into a six-second frenzy: a storm of blades follows her, she heals from damage dealt, and she shrugs off crowd control at first.

heroes.name: Kraghul
heroes.title: Chainbreaker of the Pits
heroes.lore:
The pit masters of Karth-Mor say Kraghul died eleven times in the arena, and that each death earned the crowd a better show. Nobody knows what he was before the chains. The Duskborn Pact bought his contract, bound his bones with a Bone Forge rite, and pointed him at its enemies; he went willingly, because for the first time since waking in the sand he was being asked to fight someone who stayed down.

He fights with a rusted axe and a length of chain, hauling opponents into reach and then ending the argument. Skarra the Rampant is the only fighter who ever beat him, three times, and he has never let her forget that it was luck. She says he is wrong. He says he will see her in the pit. Neither one has ever managed to stay angry long enough to make it a real feud, and neither will admit that this is the closest thing to friendship either has left.
heroes.quote: Chains are for holding the other man in place.

passive.name: Crowd's Favorite
passive.description: Kraghul ignores a portion of enemy armor. Whenever he scores a kill, his Gladiator's Hook is instantly ready again. Each blow he lands wins the crowd: attack speed rises 6% per hit, up to five hits, lasting 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Gladiator's Hook
abilities.description: Flings a chained hook. The first enemy struck is wounded and dragged all the way to Kraghul.

abilities.name: Spiked Chains
abilities.description: Whips a ring of spiked chains around himself for a few seconds, cutting and slowing everything that gets close.

abilities.name: Whip Crack
abilities.description: Cracks his chain in a wide arc, damaging and slowing every enemy in front of him.

abilities.name: Last Man Standing
abilities.description: Chains himself to an enemy and slams into them, rooting them in place for two seconds. Against another hero the slam hits much harder. Inside the duel Kraghul hits faster, hardens and steals life.

heroes.name: Rattle
heroes.title: The Fuse-Keeper
heroes.lore:
Rattle was a sapper in the Free City's mining guild, a short-tempered dwarf-sized man with a love of black powder and a firm belief that every problem was a wall in disguise. The Sundering buried his crew under three hundred tons of Mareth granite. When he woke, the rock was gone, his flesh was gone, and the last thing he remembered was a spark. He decided on the spot that the spark had been his best idea yet.

Now a Hollow sapper of the Bone Forge works, Rattle breaches walls, fortresses and the occasional bridge, usually while whistling. He and the gravetender Pell dug the Hollow's first trenches together and have been inseparable since; Pell holds the shovel, Rattle lights the fuse. Tamsin Quickfingers still owes him forty gold crowns and a barrel of powder, and he has decided to forgive the debt if she lets him blow up something expensive in return.
heroes.quote: Every wall is just a door that has not met me yet.

passive.name: Demolitionist
passive.description: Every basic attack deals bonus damage equal to a small percentage of the target's maximum health, which makes Rattle a boss and camp buster; his bombs and blasts also hit towers hard.

abilities.name: Powder Keg
abilities.description: Lobs a keg to a point. After a short fuse it explodes, damaging enemies (more against high-health targets) and blasting them back. Towers take heavy damage from it.

abilities.name: Blast Jump
abilities.description: Sets off a charge at his feet and rockets to a point, damaging and slowing enemies where he lands.

abilities.name: Sapper's Charge
abilities.description: Braces behind a shield and arms his next attack with a satchel charge, which deals heavy bonus damage based on target max health and splashes nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Chain Reaction
abilities.description: Lights every fuse he has. After a short delay a giant blast tears through a huge area, dealing heavy damage (scaled by max health) and launching enemies. Towers take heavy damage from the blast. Rattle gains a shield while the fuse burns.

heroes.name: Sable
heroes.title: Thorn of the Thornwood
heroes.lore:
Sable Thorne was the best cutpurse the Thornwood Guild ever trained, and the first to rob the Dawnguard's own vault. The Sun-Seal ring she lifted from the Bastion of Aurel is worth more than a small town and does nothing but sit on her finger, glowing slightly whenever Valen Ashcroft is within a mile. She finds this hilarious. He does not.

She works alone, mostly. Her old partner Tamsin Quickfingers sells her sword to whoever pays and remembers every job they pulled together; her former apprentice Wren has stopped writing, which Sable tells herself is a good sign. The one person she truly wants to find is Dirge, the Guildmaster who sold her to the Duskborn when she was twenty and who has since died, returned and stopped answering his name. She keeps her knives coated in nightshade for that reunion.
heroes.quote: You were never going to see it coming. That was the whole point.

passive.name: Venomed Blades
passive.description: Basic attacks coat the target in nightshade, dealing magic damage over a few seconds.

abilities.name: Throwing Knives
abilities.description: Flicks a knife in a straight line that pierces through everything in its path, wounding and slowing them. Thrown from stealth, the first blade hits for bonus damage.

abilities.name: Cloak of Thorns
abilities.description: Melts into the shadows and sprints away unseen. Her next attack from stealth strikes for bonus damage and silences the target.

abilities.name: Thorn Step
abilities.description: Slips a short distance in any direction, leaving a cloud of choking thorns that damages and slows enemies where she started.

abilities.name: Death Blossom
abilities.description: Dashes onto an enemy and unleashes a flurry of blades, striking again and again while untouchable.

heroes.name: Wren
heroes.title: The Unseen Hand
heroes.lore:
Wren was nine when Sable Thorne found her sleeping in a bell tower and eleven when she picked her first lock. Fourteen years later she is the fastest blade in the Thornwood Guild and has not spoken to her teacher in two of them. The break was nothing dramatic. Wren simply realised that Sable had never once asked where she wanted to go, and that she herself had never wondered.

She now takes contracts from any banner that pays, which has put her on the Duskborn payroll more often than she likes. She wears the hood because her face is not for sale; her eyes are. Wren keeps one rule: she does not kill for anyone who cannot look her in the eye. It is a hard rule to follow, so she mostly works from behind. Merrow the Tidewarden once asked what she was running from. She told him a story about a bell tower, and he did not ask again.
heroes.quote: I was never hiding. You were just not looking.

passive.name: Ghost Step
passive.description: Casting any ability gives Wren a short burst of speed, so she can chain blinks and kills without slowing down.

abilities.name: Boomerang Blades
abilities.description: Throws a spinning blade that cuts everything in its path, then returns to her hand, cutting everything on the way back too.

abilities.name: Shadow Blink
abilities.description: Teleports to a point and slashes everyone around her on arrival, slowing them.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.description: Shakes off every crowd control effect and fades from sight for a moment, moving faster while hidden.

abilities.name: Umbral Rush
abilities.description: Blinks forward three times in a row, carving up everything at each landing. She picks the line; nothing in it stays standing.

heroes.name: Dirge
heroes.title: The Quiet Hand
heroes.lore:
Dirge ran the Thornwood Guild for twenty years and sold half its best students to the highest bidder. When the Sundering came he was in a cellar in Mareth counting coin, and the dead found him there. The Bone Forge raised him as the one thing it could not teach: silence. He has not spoken a word since waking. He moves without the click of bone, and when he strikes there is no sound at all.

He hunts those who know where his bargains are buried. Sable Thorne was the first of his old students to learn the price of his generosity, and she is the one he most expects to come looking. Ossian, the scout he was paid to kill in the ash fields before the Hollow rose, is the one who actually does. Dirge takes contracts from both banners now, which is a trick he picked up in life. A dead man has no loyalties, he supposes. Only debts, and those he is good at collecting.
heroes.quote: The Quiet Hand takes what it is owed. (Thornwood saying)

passive.name: Reaper's Momentum
passive.description: Killing a unit instantly refreshes Shade Slip and hides Dirge from sight for a moment, so a chain of kills never has to stop.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.description: Dashes at an enemy and cuts their legs, damaging and slowing them.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: Rakes both blades through a wide arc in front of him. The more wounded an enemy is, the more it bleeds.

abilities.name: Shade Slip
abilities.description: Vanishes and reappears a short distance away, unseen for a moment and moving fast.

abilities.name: Guillotine
abilities.description: Falls on an enemy for a brutal strike that deals far more damage the less health they have left. Killing with it resets its cooldown.

heroes.name: Ysolde
heroes.title: Frostweaver of the Ivory Spire
heroes.lore:
Ysolde Vauntry became the youngest Archmage of the Ivory Spire by proving that cold is not the absence of heat but a kind of patience. At the Sundering she was the only mage in the college who did not panic: she froze the burning library solid, saved three hundred volumes and was promptly reprimanded for ruining the shelves. She has not apologised.

The Spire sent her to the Banner Wars to study the Ley Banners from a safe distance. She has not stayed safe. Her old tutor Morvane taught her everything she knows about the Sundering, then followed that knowledge into the grave and came back with opinions on how to use it; she is trying to decide whether to save him or silence him. Her former classmate Kaelen Emberfell, who burned the east wing for sport and was expelled for it, is the only person alive whose fireballs she still finds personally offensive. The Tidewarden Nerissa taught her to sing.
heroes.quote: Patience is just cold with better manners.

passive.name: Rime Touch
passive.description: Her attacks chill enemies a little, and every third hit deals bonus magic damage and slows the target heavily.

abilities.name: Glacial Lance
abilities.description: Launches a lance of ice that pierces through every enemy in its path, damaging and slowing them.

abilities.name: Frost Step
abilities.description: Blinks a short distance. A burst of frost chills enemies she left behind, and she gains a small shield on arrival.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Summons a freezing storm over a target area. Enemies inside take steady damage and are slowed.

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.description: Marks a huge circle. After a moment it flash-freezes everyone inside, dealing heavy damage and stunning them, then leaves a lingering patch of deep cold.

heroes.name: Kaelen
heroes.title: Emberfell the Exile
heroes.lore:
Kaelen Emberfell was the most gifted pyromancer the Ivory Spire had produced in a century, and the only student ever expelled for setting the east wing alight to see how it looked from the lawn. He argued, with some justice, that the east wing was already condemned. The Spire disagreed, and an exile is a very easy person for the Duskborn Pact to recruit.

Kaelen does not hate the Spire. He hates being told that fire is the wrong answer to anything. In the Pact's service he has discovered what the college never let him try: the Ley Banners respond to flame like dry kindling, and a single well-placed meteor can reroute the magic of a whole valley. His old classmate Ysolde Vauntry considers his work reckless. He considers her work cold, and has said so, loudly, across several battlefields. Their old tutor Morvane watches from the shadows, entirely too pleased.
heroes.quote: The east wing was already condemned. I merely helped.

passive.name: Ember Brand
passive.description: Casting any ability sets his next basic attack ablaze, adding bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.description: Hurls a ball of fire that damages the first enemy it strikes and then explodes, burning everything around the impact.

abilities.name: Meteor Strike
abilities.description: Calls a meteor on a target area. After a short delay it crashes down, dealing heavy damage and leaving the ground burning.

abilities.name: Backdraft
abilities.description: Vents a blast of flame in front of him, damaging enemies and throwing them back, while he gains a short burst of speed to flee.

abilities.name: Skyfall
abilities.description: Calls down a colossal meteor anywhere in a huge range. A barrage of smaller meteors rains on random spots around the target first, then the great meteor explodes for massive damage and leaves a lake of fire behind.

heroes.name: Morvane
heroes.title: Boneweaver of the Hollow
heroes.lore:
Master Orlan Morvane spent forty years at the Ivory Spire cataloguing how magic dies. He was the first to notice that the Sundering fields were not dead but sleeping, and the last to be allowed to study them. He went anyway. When the Spire's wardens finally found his body in the ash, it was sitting upright with a journal in its lap, still writing: his notes grew calmer the longer he stayed dead, and the penmanship improved.

Morvane taught Ysolde Vauntry and Kaelen Emberfell the arts they now use against each other, and he watches both from the edge of the battlefield with something he insists is pride. He raises skeletons the way other mages light candles, a polite and slightly absent-minded gesture. The Hollow gravetender Pell despises him: Morvane borrows the dead, Pell believes, and does not return them. Morvane has promised to put them back after the war. He has been promising this for some time.
heroes.quote: The dead are not gone. They are merely between jobs.

passive.name: Harvest of Souls
passive.description: Whenever Morvane gets a kill, even on a minion, a bone soldier claws its way up from the ground to fight for him.

abilities.name: Soul Spear
abilities.description: Throws a screaming spectral skull that pierces everything in a line, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.description: Raises two skeletal archers who fight for him for a short time.

abilities.name: Hex of Rot
abilities.description: Curses an enemy: they cannot cast spells for a moment, are slowed, and rot from the inside over several seconds.

abilities.name: Legion of the Hollow
abilities.description: Tears open the earth. A shockwave slows nearby enemies and a hulking bone brute and two wraiths rise to fight for him for eighteen seconds.

heroes.name: Zhal
heroes.title: Stormskull
heroes.lore:
Chaplain Zhal served Marshal Hallen's third legion as its priest of storms, a post that exists only in the Dawnguard's most northern chapels, where lightning is the closest thing to an answered prayer. He was struck by lightning at the moment of the Sundering. It did not kill him. What did was the Sundering itself, a heartbeat later, but the lightning stayed. His skull crackles when he is nervous, which is often, and there is a faint hum around his bones that dogs find unbearable.

He follows Hallen out of habit and affection, and he and the Marshal's old scout Ossian are the last of the legion who still speak to each other. Zhal is cheerful in a way that unsettles his enemies, since the dead are not supposed to enjoy things. He has taken to leaving small static shocks on door handles. His battlefield sermons are brief, loud and end the same way: with the sky answering.
heroes.quote: Hear that? That is the sky agreeing with me.

passive.name: Static Charge
passive.description: Every third basic attack releases a lightning arc that jumps to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Strikes an enemy with lightning that then jumps to up to three other nearby enemies, hitting each for the same damage.

abilities.name: Static Field
abilities.description: Charges the ground. Enemies inside take small shocks and cannot cast spells for as long as they stay in the field.

abilities.name: Storm Surge
abilities.description: Turns into a bolt and dashes in a line, shocking and slowing everyone he passes through, then attacks faster for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Stormcall
abilities.description: Summons a raging thunderstorm over a huge area. A first strike stuns everyone, and for five seconds lightning hammers everyone inside and slows them.

heroes.name: Tamsin
heroes.title: Quickfingers of Mareth
heroes.lore:
Tamsin Quickfingers will fight for whoever pays, and she will tell you so before you hire her. Born in the lanes of the Free City of Mareth, she has sold her crossbow to the Dawnguard, the Pact, three merchant princes and a travelling circus, and has switched sides in the middle of a battle only twice. Both times, she insists, the other side had better terms.

She learned to shoot from a Thornwood fence who taught her never to carry less than three escape routes. Her old partner in crime Sable Thorne still gets half her midwinter letters, and Tamsin has never mentioned that she knows exactly where the Sun-Seal ring ended up. She owes the sapper Rattle forty gold crowns and a barrel of powder. In her defense, she says, the barrel went off. In his defense, he says, it was supposed to.
heroes.quote: Gold is just courage you can carry.

passive.name: Lucky Shot
passive.description: Gains a little critical chance every level, and every third bolt hits with a bonus shot of extra damage.

abilities.name: Piercing Bolt
abilities.description: Fires a heavy bolt that punches through every enemy in a long line. Great for clearing waves.

abilities.name: Roll Out
abilities.description: Dives backwards out of danger and shoots faster for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Caltrops
abilities.description: Scatters a patch of caltrops that shreds and slows any enemy that walks across them for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Bolt Barrage
abilities.description: Empties her quiver in a rapid volley, firing eight piercing bolts down a line in under a second.

heroes.name: Merrow
heroes.title: Harpooner of the Grey Tide
heroes.lore:
Merrow grew up on the cold coast where the Tidewardens listen to the sea and hunt what the sea throws up. His sister Nerissa took the druid's path and learned the songs. Merrow took the harpoon and learned the dark water, where he fought something no Warden will name aloud and came home with a scar the shape of a hook. He still sleeps with his boots on.

The Sundering sent the sea into the ash fields, and with it the things that live at the bottom. Merrow follows them inland. He is patient, laconic and a very good shot, and he fights from a distance because the things he hunts prefer to be close. Nerissa worries and says so. Wren the Thornwood assassin is the only other person who has ever asked him why he never talks about the scar. She did not ask twice, and he has not forgotten the courtesy.
heroes.quote: The sea gives back everything. Eventually.

passive.name: Sea Legs
passive.description: Each harpoon he lands gives Merrow a short burst of speed, which lets him kite melee enemies all day.

abilities.name: Pinning Harpoon
abilities.description: Hurls a harpoon that damages the first enemy hit and pins them in place for a second.

abilities.name: Riptide Roll
abilities.description: Rolls forward on a rush of water, then splashes outwards, hitting and shoving away anything close.

abilities.name: Sharpened Line
abilities.description: Tightens his lines, gaining a lot of attack speed and a little extra reach for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Kraken Call
abilities.description: Calls a tentacle from the deep. After a short delay it erupts, hurling every enemy in the area into the air, and leaves the ground churning and slowing.

heroes.name: Ossian
heroes.title: Longshot of the Unburied
heroes.lore:
Ossian was Marshal Hallen's best scout, a quiet man who could place a bolt through a keyhole at two hundred paces and who vanished on the first night of the Sundering, hired to be killed. He woke in the ash fields with a crossbow bolt in his skull and no memory of the shooter, only a name: Dirge. The Hollow did not choose him. He chose them, because at last there was a place where no one would ask him to stop looking.

He serves under Hallen again, in a way. The Marshal gives orders, Ossian listens, and then does what he thinks is right, which has always worked out better. He takes slow, careful shots from impossible distances, and he never wastes a bolt. Dirge is on his list, along with a short and growing set of names he hopes to cross out before the Banner Wars end. He is in no hurry. The dead, he has found, are patient hunters.
heroes.quote: One shot. I only ever needed one.

passive.name: Marked for the Grave
passive.description: After casting an ability, his next basic attack reaches farther and hits for bonus damage while slowing the target.

abilities.name: Longshot
abilities.description: A single, fast, extremely accurate bolt with a long range and heavy damage.

abilities.name: Hollow Snare
abilities.description: Drops a ghostly snare on the ground. After a heartbeat it springs, damaging and rooting everyone inside.

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.description: Plants his feet in a sniper's stance for five seconds, gaining much longer reach and extra attack damage, but he moves a quarter slower while it lasts.

abilities.name: Judgment from the Grave
abilities.description: Fires a colossal bolt across half the map. It travels incredibly far, hits the first enemy hard (more if they are wounded) and slows them.

heroes.name: Seraphine
heroes.title: Lightwarden of the Dawn
heroes.lore:
Seraphine Vane took her vows as a Lightwarden the morning after the Sundering, when she found her brother Aldric asleep on his feet and covered in other men's blood. The Lightwardens do not heal with potions; they channel what little of the Old Crown's glow still lingers in Aurel's stones. It is a gift that drains her, and she has never once refused to give it.

She patches Aldric after every battle and scolds him for it. She also lights a candle each night for Marshal Hallen, the man who taught her brother to stand, and she has not yet decided whether the thing that now walks the ash fields in his armor deserves one. Tidewarden Nerissa taught her to listen to the sea when her own light ran thin. In return Seraphine taught Nerissa to curse in High Aurelian, which has proved useful for both of them.
heroes.quote: Light does not ask whose side you are on. Hold still and let it work.

passive.name: Radiant Strikes
passive.description: Each basic attack sheds a pulse of light that heals nearby allies for a small amount.

abilities.name: Judgment Beam
abilities.description: Fires a piercing lance of light that burns every enemy it crosses and mends every ally it passes through.

abilities.name: Aegis of Dawn
abilities.description: Blesses an ally with a shield, cleanses their crowd control and quickens their step. Seraphine gains a smaller shield.

abilities.name: Sanctified Ground
abilities.description: Consecrates the ground. Allies standing in it are steadily healed while enemies are scorched and slowed.

abilities.name: Intercession
abilities.description: Reaches across the whole battlefield to an ally: heals them, cleanses them and shields them from all damage for a moment. Allies beside them are healed too.

heroes.name: Nerissa
heroes.title: Tidecaller of the Grey Shore
heroes.lore:
Nerissa grew up on the Grey Shore, where the Tidewardens hold that all water is one water and every wave is a sentence in a very old prayer. When the Sundering tore the Old Crown apart, she was the first of her people to hear the sea change its tune. She left the coast the same week, bringing her songs, her tide-book and her younger brother's harpoon, which she insisted he carry whether he wanted to or not.

She now travels with whichever army needs healing, which is all of them. Ysolde of the Ivory Spire taught her formal magic and she taught Ysolde to sing in return; the exchange has gone better for the singer. Seraphine of the Dawnguard is the only healer she has ever met whose light she finds restful. And her brother Merrow, the harpooner, is the one thing she cannot soothe, so she keeps trying, sending him shells with messages scratched into them. He keeps all of them.
heroes.quote: Every wave comes home eventually. Let me carry you back with it.

passive.name: Tidebound
passive.description: Every spell she casts sends a rush of water around her, giving nearby allies (and herself) a short burst of speed.

abilities.name: Mending Tide
abilities.description: Sends a wave of healing to an ally that then leaps to up to two other nearby allies, healing each of them.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.description: Floods an area with a strong current. Enemies are slowed and damaged; allies are carried along faster.

abilities.name: Tidal Embrace
abilities.description: Wraps an ally in a healing whirlpool that follows them for several seconds, healing everyone allied who stands inside.

abilities.name: Tsunami
abilities.description: Calls a gigantic wave that sweeps across the battlefield, launching and damaging every enemy it crosses and healing and shielding every ally.

heroes.name: Pell
heroes.title: Gravetender of the Fields
heroes.lore:
Pell was the gravedigger of a small village on the edge of the Sundering fields, a cheerful old man who believed that everyone deserves a tidy resting place and a few kind words. When the dead started rising, he did not run. He took his shovel, apologised to the first one, and put it back in the ground. By the end of the week he had re-buried two hundred. By the end of the month, he had joined them, and still carried on.

Now Pell tends the Hollow, doing what he has always done: making sure the dead are looked after. He heals them, shields them and sometimes rattles a few of the more energetic ones into helping with the war effort. His best friend is the sapper Rattle, who blows things up while Pell puts them back together. He has no patience for the necromancer Morvane, who he feels treats the dead like equipment. The two have not spoken since Morvane tried to borrow a graveyard.
heroes.quote: Everyone gets a resting place. Some of us just take longer to settle in.

passive.name: Fresh Plots
passive.description: Whenever Pell gets a kill, even on a minion, a pulse of comfort heals Pell and every ally close to him.

abilities.name: Skull Lob
abilities.description: Lobs a skull that homes in on an enemy, damaging them and cracking their armor and magic resistance for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Grave Guard
abilities.description: Digs up two bone soldiers to guard him and gains a shield.

abilities.name: Bone Broth
abilities.description: Serves up a steaming pot of broth. Nearby allies (and Pell) are healed and gain a short burst of speed and attack speed.

abilities.name: Mass Grave
abilities.description: Consecrates a wide plot of ground for six seconds. Allies in it are healed over time; enemies are slowed and shaken by the dead below. Two skeleton archers rise to defend it.

fortress.name: Fortress Core
fortress.description: Destroy it to win. Shielded by its banners.

miner.name: Miner
miner.description: Mines gold from veins and carries it to your fortress. Your economy.

swordsman.name: Swordsman
swordsman.description: Cheap, quick melee infantry. Strength in numbers.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Fragile crossbow archer. Shoots from behind the front line; +50% damage against Giants.

shieldbearer.name: Shieldbearer
shieldbearer.description: Heavy armoured infantry that holds the line.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Fast dual-blade killer that dives archers and mages.

battlemage.name: Battlemage
battlemage.description: Hurls fireballs that burn every enemy around the target.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Mends wounded allies (heroes too) instead of fighting.

giant.name: Giant
giant.description: A towering brute whose axe sweeps whole squads aside.

forge.name: Forge
forge.description: Researches weapon and armour upgrades for your army.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Shoots enemies that reach your base. Stack them for a deadly gate.

weapons.name: Sharpened Steel
weapons.text: +15% army damage and +10% healing per level

armor.name: Tempered Plate
armor.text: +8 armor and magic resist per level
